name: Native KQ-SVD vs key-only SVD and source-trained linear-code negative control
aim: Validate strong query-aware native baseline and same-byte linear-code falsifier, not prove any Mirror-specific benefit.
limitations: synthetic keys/queries only, no LM NLL
score-space rank-r SVD oracle is not directly deployable without counting projector/state
target-role support exact scores constitute expensive oracle calibration, never free
target audit query scores cannot train projector/code

environment.model: one head linear pre-softmax score proxy

generator: For each world: a fixed random orthogonal feature frame V; K=Z diag(linspace(4.0,0.12,d)) V.T (128x16); each role Q sampled in the same V coordinate frame with scale biased toward lower K singular directions; disjoint support and audit queries. Source 6 roles have different mixtures, target is unseen role mixture. Exact scores Q K.T are allowed for support-based code fitting only, not for audit fitting.
methods: K-only SVD of K with rank-r right projector
per-role truncated SVD of Q_audit K.T as an AUDIT ORACLE LOWER BOUND (never used to tune deployable model)
source-only native KQ-score rank-r projector calibrated on 96 independent source queries per role
source-only shared flattened projector dictionary + target-code fit on 12 permitted support queries
same dictionary linear m control is native and makes no Mirror specific claim
measurements: relative Frobenius attention-score error on heldout audit query
oracle SVD error <= any rank-r approximation
least-squares projector shape and numerical residual
actual named NPZ serialized inference projector-basis bytes

gates.algebra_PASS: every fresh role projector is rank<=r (+ numerical tolerance) and its calibration score matches truncated SVD within 1e-7 relative, assuming full column rank
gates.native_OPTIMALITY_PASS: oracle rank-r SVD audit Frobenius error <= K-only score error + 1e-10 in all fresh worlds
gates.Mirror_specific_PASS: Not evaluated by this pilot. Ordinary linear m is a mandatory null, no innovation claim.
gates.FAIL: oracle bound is exceeded in the wrong direction or implementation does not correctly calibrate/deploy source-only projector
gates.UNCERTAIN: rank deficient calibration, invalid source/audit split, poor numerical condition, or serializer not measured

fresh_use: Run dev 3 and all 5 fresh once; report all rows; no results used to revise preregistered gates.
